Leaders Meet at APEC Summit in Shenzhen

Russian President Vladimir Putin and Chinese President Xi Jinping met on the sidelines of the APEC summit in Shenzhen on Wednesday, November 18. The leaders and their delegations had lunch together. Xi Jinping urged closer political and military ties between China and Russia. U.S. President Donald Trump also arrived in Shenzhen for trilateral talks with Xi and Putin. The meetings could address trade, new export controls, and tensions in the Middle East, though the leaders maintain conflicting strategic interests.
